summary.zh: 用变基、拣选、二分与 reflog 处理复杂历史
summary.en: Handle complex history with rebase, bisect, and reflog

description.zh: 覆盖变基、cherry-pick、bisect、worktree 和 reflog 的用法，用于整理提交历史、定位引入回归的提交以及找回误删内容。适合多人协作的功能分支管理和仓库故障恢复。
description.en: Covers rebase, cherry-pick, bisect, worktrees, and reflog for cleaning up history, finding regression commits, and recovering lost work. Useful for feature-branch collaboration and repo troubleshooting.
